publisher: Ares bot direct POST followed by exact GET; no scheduler footer
period: current Eastern civil day 00:00 inclusive through fixed 18:08 inclusive; not a closed full-day report
date_source: Meta created_time, never date tokens in campaign name or launch/start_time
counting: unique campaign ID; includes new-from-zero, clones and duplications; independent of current accepted status
excluded_api_literal: DELETED is rejected by the list edge; ARCHIVED includes terminal objects exposed by Meta. Objects not exposed by the API cannot be guaranteed.
grouping: manager responsible for account from canonical catalog; not verified human creator identity
layout: six manager totals plus aligned manager-by-site matrix with row and column totals
unavailable: n/d for any incomplete cell; never replace missing data with zero; partial totals explicitly observed only
credentials: existing SHEIN-US-DIRECT credential_architecture.shared_car_shein_bisu.token_item; no rotation, alternative identity or global discovery
recovery: resume saved account cursors in same fixed snapshot; retry only unavailable accounts; durable per-day outbox with nonce and exact GET; ambiguous POST never blindly repeated
scope_change: fail closed if canonical 6x6 catalog or authority drifts; scope check each host and account before API
